items.title: Should You Buy IBM Stock For Its Cash?
items.summary: IBM's free cash flow equals 6.3% of its market value, against 4.5% for the median S&P 500 company. A yield that high means one of two things: investors are underpricing a sound business, or they expect it to shrink. Which of those is IBM—and is its cash strong enough to justify buying now, or should investors wait for proof.
